anthropic.source: Anthropic first-party API list pricing, as recorded in the bundled claude-api skill reference (Current Models table).
anthropic.cache_multipliers_source: claude-api skill, shared/prompt-caching.md: cache reads ~0.1x base input; cache writes 1.25x for 5-minute TTL and 2x for 1-hour TTL. Cache rates below are those multipliers applied to the model's input rate.
caveats: First-party Claude API rates. Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI are partner-operated with separate pricing and are NOT covered by this table.

Fast mode (speed=fast) on Claude Opus 5 is billed at 10.00/50.00 rather than the standard rate. This table does not model request-level speed, so fast-mode calls are under-costed. Supply an override if you use fast mode.

claude-sonnet-5.note: Source lists an introductory rate of 2.00/10.00 through 2026-08-31. This table records the standard rate; costs computed for calls made during the introductory window are therefore over-stated. Supply an override to model the introductory rate.
